annotations.title: Record that a quote was declined

description: Records on a sale quote or a purchase order that the other party declined it: declined_at, now or the moment the user gives. Nothing is booked; its quote_status becomes declined. Where the crm module holds a deal that carries this quote and no other quote of that deal is still alive, the deal is lost. Refused by name on an invoice (document_not_answerable), on an accepted quote (document_already_answered: undo_document_answer first), for a moment to come (answer_in_the_future). Held to the company's agent_posting as a posting is (approval_required in review without a person's approval). Ask the user before calling it. This session follows each company's agent_posting.

at.description: When the other party answered: an ISO date or timestamp, as the user says it. Left out: now. Never in the future (answer_in_the_future).

document_id.description: The sale quote or purchase order the other party declined.
